case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4718 OF 2022; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 329-332 OF 2023

parties.respondent: M/S Magnum International Trading Company Pvt. Ltd.

summary: Consumer association's maintainability in consumer complaint despite registration challenge; registration valid under HRRS Act; Consumer Protection Act 1986 sec.2(b) sec.12 interpreted liberal pro-consumer approach; inconsistent bylaw arguments dismissed; writ pendency unrelated to consumer dispute; adjournment sine die improper, proceedings to proceed on merits; individual allottees' affidavits sufficient for maintainability.
legal_provisions_cited: Haryana Registration and Regulation of Societies Act, 2012
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; National Commission orders set aside; consumer complaints to be adjudicated on merits.
